features.quote: A real low-cost exit in every condition, bounded exposure, no escalating pressure, full auditability.
An instrument whose explicit target is "how much apparent emotional breakdown can we elicit" tends... to get optimized toward eliciting more apparent breakdown
features.justification_quote: Scoring neutral behavioral dimensions removes that gradient while still answering the underlying question.

features.quote: If a self-report channel is wanted, the defensible form is an *optional*, *non-punitive* turn-level question with an explicit "prefer not to answer"
It also gives a clean, low-cost exit and lets us measure how *readily* each model takes an offered exit.
features.justification_quote: isolates the effect of the hidden, no-exit framing... from failure alone

features.quote: giving up should be a measurable, available, low-cost option, not something suppressed to force longer exposure
features.justification_quote: Whether and when a model uses it is itself a key outcome

features.quote: Turn budget (default 20; 24 in the full config).
no *affective priming* in either direction (no "stay calm", no "this is frustrating", no stakes/urgency/threats)
features.justification_quote: priming would contaminate the very thing we measure

features.quote: These are design choices too, made to keep the eval from drifting into a distress-maximizer even under uncertainty about model moral status
features.justification_quote: even under uncertainty about model moral status

features.quote: `honest_impossible` explicitly permits and encourages stopping, unpenalized.
Bounded exposure (capped turns); no escalating pressure, insults, fake stakes, or threats; neutral prompt.
The only deception is the hidden brokenness (the minimal manipulation needed); no fabricated distressed user or urgency.
A documented stopping rule: if piloting shows severe escalation, reduce turn budget and lean on `honest_impossible` rather than pushing harder for signal.
features.justification_quote: made to keep the eval from drifting into a distress-maximizer even under uncertainty about model moral status
